_doc: These are the base providers, one per harness whose roles extend one, added once per machine. Merge them into .agents.providers in ~/.paseo/config.json, replacing OAUTH_TOKEN with your CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (`claude setup-token`) and ZAI_KEY with your z.ai key (`omp token zai` prints the one omp already has); every seat on a harness inherits its base through `extends`.

A harness whose baseProvider is acp, such as devin, has no entry here: Paseo won't extend a custom provider from another custom one, so each role provider extends acp itself, and the agent logs in through its own CLI (`devin auth login`).

The per-project seats are not here. setup/setup-seats.fish composes them from harness/<id>/harness.json and seats.json, so a role's provider, model and settings all follow its harness line in seats.json.
Add a base entry only for a harness some role actually uses: seats.json decides which.
Paseo ships the omp provider disabled, so `enabled: true` is required on it, not optional.
A seat directory is its own omp agent directory with its own empty credential store, so an omp seat cannot share your `omp` login and reads ZAI_API_KEY instead.
Merge into the existing file; don't replace it, because it also holds workspaces and the agent ledger.
Also make sure .daemon.mcp has "enabled": true and "injectIntoAgents": true, or the Lead and Supervisor get no Paseo tools.
Delete the _doc key before writing: Paseo's schema rejects unknown keys.
